# TikTok Auto-Posting Machine — Real Architecture

*Generated by Phase 1 Reality Audit. This document reflects the actual implementation, not the README claims.*

---

## Component Responsibilities

### 1. Entry Points (Executable Scripts)

| Script | Started By | Schedule | Purpose |
|--------|------------|----------|---------|
| `orchestrator.py` | systemd (`tiktok-machine.service`) | Continuous (2h loop) | **Primary** autonomous scheduler |
| `upload_orchestrator.py` | Manual / legacy | N/A | **Duplicate** orchestrator, not used in production |
| `telegram_bot.py` | Started by orchestrator | Background thread | Command interface (`/status`, `/growth`, `/pause`, etc.) |
| `server.py` (webapp) | systemd (`tiktok-webapp.service`) | Continuous (FastAPI) | Web dashboard API + static frontend |
| `video_processor.py` | orchestrator (import) | Per-cycle | Render one video with overlay → queue |
| `uploader.py` | orchestrator (import) | Per-cycle | Upload one queued video via TiktokAU |
| `sync_drive.py` | orchestrator (import) | Per-cycle + manual | rclone pull from GDrive → content/raw/ |
| `sync_out.py` | orchestrator (import) | After successful upload | rclone push logs/processed + delete posted raws from GDrive |
| `check_burns.py` | orchestrator (import) | Per-cycle (quality gate) | ffprobe scan queue, quarantine 1-frame burns |
| `ai_growth.py` | Telegram `/growth` + daily job | Manual + 3AM MYT | AI strategy report + 10 captions/product |
| `competitor_scraper.py` | orchestrator daily job | 3AM MYT | Apify scrape → competitor_videos/daily tables |
| `generate_report.py` | orchestrator daily job | After scrape | OPS report → daily_report.txt + Telegram |
| `reconcile_metrics.py` | orchestrator daily job | After scrape | Match uploads to scraped metrics |
| `compliance.py` | video_processor, webapp | Per-caption | Two-layer compliance (regex + AI) |
| `caption_policy.py` | compliance, video_processor | Per-caption | Regex lexicon + obfuscation + repair |
| `transform_video.py` | video_processor (import) | Per-video | 8 TikTok styles + Skia/Playwright renderer |
| `sidecar_manager.py` | video_processor, uploader | Per-video | .json + .pid sidecars for queue |
| `db.py` | All modules | On import | SQLite wrapper with schema |
| `lib.py` | All modules | On import | Config, paths, timezone, proxy, quality, DB helpers |
| `import_cookies.py` | Manual | One-time | Browser cookie JSON → TiktokAU pickle |
| `qr_login.py` | Manual / Telegram `/relogin` | One-time | Headless Playwright QR login → cookies |
| `setup_tools.py` | Manual | One-time | Config verify, DB init, seed captions, proxy test |

### 2. TiktokAutoUploader (The Upload Engine)

**Location**: `/home/archery/ai-project/tiktokflows_arena.AI/TiktokAutoUploader/`

| Module | Role |
|--------|------|
| `tiktok_v2.py` | **Current** `upload_video()` with product anchors (type=33) |
| `tiktok.py` | Legacy `upload_video()` without product anchors |
| `Browser.py` | Undetected-chromedriver wrapper for login only |
| `cookies.py` | Pickle load/save for session cookies |
| `Config.py` | Config.txt parser (COOKIES_DIR, VIDEOS_DIR, etc.) |
| `bot_utils.py` | Signature generation (Node.js), tag parsing, AWS auth |
| `api/` | FastAPI REST API (accounts, uploads, schedules, videos) - **not used by orchestrator** |
| `scheduler/` | APScheduler-based scheduler - **not used by orchestrator** |
| `novnc/` | noVNC control server for containerized login - **not used** |

**Key Fact**: The orchestrator calls `tiktok_uploader.tiktok_v2.upload_video()` directly via Python import. It does NOT use the TiktokAutoUploader API, CLI, or scheduler.

## Data Flow

```
Google Drive (rclone remote: gdrive:TikTokContent)
       │
       ▼ sync_drive.py (rclone copy --exclude processed/failed/posted)
content/raw/<Product>/raw_001.mp4
       │
       ▼ VideoProcessor.scan_raw() + DB raw_stock (excludes posted_at)
       ▼ check_burns.py (quality gate on queue dir)
       ▼ VideoProcessor.process_one()
           ├─ Pick product (weighted: stock * performance, penalize recent)
           ├─ Pick raw video (random from least-used)
           ├─ Generate caption (preset pool + hooks/CTAs/emojis + policy gate)
           ├─ Render overlay PNG (Skia primary, 8 styles, emoji support)
           ├─ FFmpeg encode (CRF 23, maxrate 5M, eof_action=repeat)
           ├─ Quality check (frames ≥ 10, MB/s ≥ 0.30)
           ├─ Archive raw → content/processed/<Product>/
           ├─ Write deleted.log (audit only)
           ├─ DB: mark_raw_consumed() → raw_stock.posted_at = now (SOURCE OF TRUTH)
           └─ Write sidecars (.json + .pid) → content/processed/queue/
       │
       ▼ Uploader.upload()
           ├─ Find newest mp4 with sidecar
           ├─ Verify proxy exit IP (ip-api.com → ipinfo.io, ~2KB)
           ├─ Strict mode: abort if non-MY or datacenter
           ├─ Anti-bot jitter (5-90s)
           ├─ tiktok_v2.upload_video() with proxy + product anchors
           ├─ Retry on TikTok API failure (2x, backoff)
           ├─ NO retry on proxy transport error (protects metered GB)
           ├─ On success: log analytics, cleanup sidecars + mp4, success.log
           └─ On fail: move to failed/ with reason.txt, failed.log
       │
       ▼ sync_out.py (after success)
           ├─ rclone copy logs + processed/ → GDrive
           ├─ DB: SELECT raw_stock WHERE posted_at IS NOT NULL AND drive_cleaned_at IS NULL
           ├─ rclone deletefile each from GDrive
           └─ DB: mark_drive_cleaned()
       │
       ▼ Daily Jobs (3 AM MYT)
           ├─ competitor_scraper.py → competitor_videos, competitor_daily, competitor_data
           ├─ reconcile_metrics.py → match videos.tiktok_video_id via caption/time
           ├─ generate_report.py → daily_report.txt (stock, posted, performance)
           └─ ai_growth.py (if /growth triggered) → growth_report.txt + preset_text.txt
```

## Configuration Architecture

**Single source**: `config/config.yaml` (git-ignored, holds secrets)

**Loading**: `lib.config()` → cached `_CFG` dict → `lib.cfg(*path)` for nested access

**Layers**:
1. `config.yaml` (primary)
2. Environment variables (override specific: `TIKTOKFLOW_HOME`, `TIKTOK_MACHINE_CONFIG`, `TIKTOKFLOW_TZ`, `TIKTOK_SESSION_USER`, `TIKTOK_RIVAL_HANDLE`, `TIKTOK_PROXY`, `AI_API_KEY`)
3. Hardcoded defaults in `lib.py` and each module

**No**: Multiple config files, config classes, or validation schema.

---

## Database Architecture

**Single SQLite file**: `logs/tiktok.db` (WAL mode, foreign_keys=ON)

**Operational Tables** (from `db.py`):
- `posts` — Upload records (PENDING→TRANSFORMING→POSTED/FAILED)
- `raw_stock` — **Ledger**: every raw video, `posted_at` = consumed (source of truth)
- `caption_pool` — Approved captions per product (compliance_checked flag)
- `competitor_data` — Legacy dashboard table (from Apify)
- `system_events` — Audit log (UPLOAD_SUCCESS, PROXY_FAIL, etc.)

**Analytics Tables** (from `lib.py` SCHEMA):
- `videos` — Local upload log (invented video_id)
- `daily_metrics` — Scraped metrics per video per day
- `competitor_videos` — Per-video scraped data (handle, views, sound, hashtags)
- `competitor_daily` — Per-handle daily aggregates
- `daily_summary` — AI growth cache (ai_called_at = daily budget gate)

**Key Design**: `raw_stock.posted_at` is the **single source of truth** for "already posted". Drive deletion is cosmetic cleanup only.

---

## Concurrency Model

| Component | Concurrency |
|-----------|-------------|
| Orchestrator | Single-threaded loop (systemd restarts on crash) |
| Telegram bot | Background thread (asyncio event loop) |
| Web API | FastAPI + uvicorn (multi-worker capable) |
| SQLite | WAL mode → concurrent reads, serialized writes |
| rclone | Single transfer (`--transfers 1`) |
| TiktokAU | Single upload at a time (flock lock in uploader.py) |
| AI calls | Sequential, cached (1/day) |

**No**: Message queues, worker pools, or distributed coordination.

## External Dependencies

| Service | Purpose | Auth | Called By |
|---------|---------|------|-----------|
| TikTok Web API | Video upload | Session cookies (sessionid, tt-target-idc) | `tiktok_v2.py` |
| Google Drive | Content storage | rclone OAuth token | `sync_drive.py`, `sync_out.py` |
| Telegram Bot API | Notifications + control | Bot token | `telegram_bot.py` |
| OpenAI-compatible API | Captions, compliance, strategy | API key | `ai_growth.py`, `compliance.py`, `compliance_engine.py` |
| Apify (clockworks/tiktok-scraper) | Competitor scraping | API token | `competitor_scraper.py` |
| ip-api.com / ipinfo.io | Proxy geo verification | None (free tier) | `lib.check_proxy_exit()`, `uploader.verify_proxy()` |
| Cloudflare Tunnel | Web access (no open ports) | Tunnel token | `cloudflared.service` |

├── config/

├── logs/

│   ├── burn_log.jsonl              # VideoProcessor audit trail
│   ├── deleted.log                 # Audit: raw files archived (not load-bearing)
│   ├── success.log                 # Successful uploads

│   ├── growth_report.txt           # AI growth output
│   ├── daily_report.txt            # OPS report
│   └── drive_cleanup.log           # sync_out audit
├── scripts/                        # All pipeline modules (see CODE_MAP.md)
├── webapp/
│   ├── server.py                   # FastAPI backend
│   └── static/                     # index.html, style.css, app.js
├── deploy/                         # systemd services, setup.sh
├── docs/                           # Guides
├── TiktokAutoUploader/             # Upload engine (separate repo, vendored)

│   ├── api/                        # FastAPI (unused by orchestrator)
│   └── scheduler/                  # APScheduler (unused)

## Security Model

- All services run as `tiktok` system user (non-root)
- Telegram bot only responds to `allowed_user_id`
- Web interface behind Cloudflare Tunnel (no open ports)
- Secrets in `config.yaml` (git-ignored), masked in API responses
- Proxy used **only for upload traffic**; AI/Telegram/Apify use direct VPS IP
- SQLite WAL mode for concurrent read safety
- Failed burns quarantined, never uploaded
- Raw videos never deleted, only archived
- Cookie files stored locally, only sent to TikTok API
